title: Underived total tensor comparison through the canonical affine chart
statement: Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme], $A=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$, and $P^\bullet,N^\bullet$ arbitrary unbounded cochain complexes of $A$-modules. Write $C$ for termwise associated sheaf on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections] followed by termwise restriction along $X.\operatorname{toSpec}\Gamma$ [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits]. There is an isomorphism of cochain complexes $\operatorname{Tot}(C(P^\bullet)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X} C(N^\bullet))\cong C(\operatorname{Tot}(P^\bullet\otimes_A N^\bullet))$, with total tensor as in [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. No K-flatness or derived localization occurs.

proof.text: For coefficient modules U,V, the affine tilde tensor comparison identifies tilde(U tensor V) with tilde(U) tensor tilde(V). Restrict this identification along the canonical affine chart, then use the restriction tensor comparison. The defining pure-tensor formulas give naturality in both coefficient modules: for either module map, both composites send the germ of u tensor v to the corresponding tensor of image germs.

Tilde is left adjoint to global sections, so preserves coproducts. Open restriction also preserves coproducts. In degree n, combine their coproduct comparison with the coefficient tensor isomorphism on every summand (p,q) with p+q=n. Naturality identifies each first differential and each signed second differential. Equivalently apply HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorComparison to the natural coefficient comparison. Since the coefficient comparison is invertible and the functor preserves all the totalization coproducts, this chain map is invertible. Reverse its orientation to obtain the stated isomorphism. No finiteness condition is used, and empty or zero examples use the same construction.
